blackboard.repo_purpose: Long-only spot crypto trading bot (Kraken) + an honest research pipeline. Live trading is OFF by default (LIVE_TRADING=true to enable) because the strategy measures net-negative.
blackboard.known_findings: See ROADMAP.md. Established with real numbers: the swing-structure entry is statistically indistinguishable from random (8,203 trades); gross-of-cost expectancy is ~0 so cheaper fills cannot rescue it; exit-model and stop-placement sweeps both came back negative. Do not re-test these without new data - it is already answered.
blackboard.in_flight: Order-flow backfills for ETH/SOL are running as background node processes (research.js flow). They write to candles/*.csv every 100 pages. Do NOT kill node processes or touch candles/ - that is live data collection, and killing it loses hours of API paging.
blackboard.open_question: Does order flow (aggressor imbalance, trade intensity, big-print share) predict forward returns? Harness is flowsignal.mjs; run with --pool once backfills finish.
